causality.statement: Gauss-Bonnet coefficient alpha = l^2 in h(psi) = psi + alpha psi^2 + ...; CEMZ causality requires higher-spin states at m_HS <~ 1/l = M_D/c_l (O(1) factor not fixed)
causality.reference: Camanho, Edelstein, Maldacena, Zhiboedov, JHEP 02 (2016) 020, arXiv:1407.5597

lambda_c.note: the false vacuum must have rho comparable to the curvature-bound density (cutoff scale)

spin_down.note: Myers-Perry proxy: superradiant spin-down can release up to E_rot as visible TeV-scale quanta even at T = 0

discharge.baseline: neutral remnant (colour discharges in ~0.01 fm/c, then e+e- emission removes integer charge)
discharge.alternative: if colour discharge were suppressed: R-hadron-like dressing with charged fraction ~0.3-0.5
